messages:
riley_devex: quick recap from today's sync: proposal to add 'Schema filter' to run history + a pin button in the schema editor so teams can pin versions for replay. initial thoughts?

jo_design: like the filter. ascii idea: 
[Run history]  Filter: [All v] [Pinned only] [Schema: translate:v2]

maia_prod: must be able to "pin" a schema from the editor and surface pinned versions in the run dropdown. copy: 'Pin schema for replay'.

sam_a11y: a11y nits: filter controls need labels, role=combobox, and keyboard shortcuts (Cmd+K to open filter). pinned items must have accessible names and be readable by SR. contrast for pin icon >= 4.5.

trent_eng: implementation notes: store snapshots when pinning, add index for efficient lookup. replay should be opt-in (button: 'Replay run with pinned schema'). avoid rewriting history unless user confirms.

maia_prod: UX: in schema editor show small banner when current schema differs from pinned: 'You are editing an unpinned draft' with CTA 'Save as pinned'.

ji_design: microcopy tweak: use 'Apply pinned schema' for the replay CTA and tooltip 'Runs using this schema' for pinned selector.

ci-bot: test-check: add unit/E2E tests for filter combos, pin/unpin, replay flow, and keyboard access. CI will block missing tests. :robot_face:

riley_devex: action list: 1) add schema filter UI in run history; 2) pin/unpin affordance in schema editor + banner; 3) replay button (opt-in) per run; 4) SR labels & keyboard shortcuts; 5) backend snapshots & index; 6) tests. I'll mock and post a quick prototype. thanks! :rocket:
